pages.text: Aluminium is everywhere in the electrical age: the $(item)steel mechanism$() needs it, and so do aluminium wire, pipes and the centrifuge. It all starts with $(item)Bauxite$(), a stone block.$(br2)$(l)Crushing$()$(br)Run Bauxite through Create's $(item)Crushing Wheels$(). Each block gives:
$(li)$(item)2 Bauxite Powder$() with a 75% chance,$(li)$(item)1 more$() Bauxite Powder with a 20% chance.$(br2)That is about 1.7 powder per block on average, so mine plenty.

$(l)Two ways to aluminium$()$(li)$(item)Superheated mixing$() in a Create basin: easy to build, needs no electricity, but costs coal coke dust and gives a single ingot per batch.$(li)$(item)Electrolysis$() in a chemical vat: needs power and a heated vat, but gives more metal for the same powder.
Use the first to make your first ingots (you need aluminium to build the generators that power the second), then switch to electrolysis.
